credits_text: A FILM BY ELI JARSKY STARRING JACOB PACKARD AND JOHN O'MEARA
other_text: As of September 8, 2025, I have completed a preliminary Hillwood College Theatre Troupe audition. I acknowledge that this virtual serves as a callback, and by staying in this basement until I may earn my spot as a Player, I have not and will not accept a callback from any other performance group on campus. I will make big choices.
description: A black-and-white poster for a film titled 'Hillwood College Theatre Troupe Callbacks,' featuring a close-up of a person and text detailing audition details and credits.
